summary: Validated Stream Parsing optimization and Cloud Storage Adapters. All 40 backend tests pass (test_storage_adapters.py 4/4, test_csv_dialect.py 6/6, test_hardening_phase2.py 8/8, test_hardening_security.py 5/5, backend_test.py 17/17). benchmark_optimized_stream.py confirms 250MB CSV -> 230.77MB clean output, rows_in==rows_out (4,032,984) integrity, incremental disk writing via storage.create_destination_path. Storage abstraction verified: UUID-based keys (uuid.uuid4().hex.ext) never expose original filenames; LocalStorageAdapter, VercelBlobStorageAdapter fallback, S3StorageAdapter contract, TTL cleanup all pass. Frontend loads correctly at preview URL.

minor.issue: Memory delta for 250MB benchmark was +712MB RSS. Streaming writes to disk incrementally but Python/pandas working set still grows during long execution. rows integrity is preserved; documented for future tuning.

critical_code_review_comments: storage.py cleanly separates StorageService abstraction; RecipeExecutionService uses storage.create_destination_path so engine is storage-agnostic (verified at recipe_service.py:305).
server.py stream-process endpoint (line 705) properly streams UploadFile to disk in 1MB chunks with 300MB hard cap, and immediately unlinks temp input after execution — good memory hygiene.
UUID-based keys ensure user filenames are never exposed as storage paths (storage.py:57,65).

VercelBlobStorageAdapter currently delegates to local cache — this is documented as fallback for dev. When BLOB_READ_WRITE_TOKEN is present in prod, the save_file path still uses local_cache (line 110). Consider wiring actual Vercel Blob HTTP upload when token provided — currently a no-op branch. Not blocking (matches contract).

Memory audit: 250MB CSV -> +712MB RSS. Chunk read+transform+incremental write works but pandas chunks may not be released promptly. Consider explicit `del chunk; gc.collect()` after each chunk in execute_stream_csv for tighter RAM footprint.
seed_data_creation: None (benchmarks generate synthetic CSVs in-place and clean up)
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 40 pytest tests + benchmark_optimized_stream.py pass. Storage adapter contract confirmed. If tuning memory further, look at recipe_service.execute_stream_csv chunk lifecycle (line 305 onward). Frontend UI not exhaustively re-tested this iteration since scope was backend storage/streaming.
